### DELIBERATELY IMPLAUSIBLE NUMBERS (M74) ###
Every figure below is a fixture value chosen so that it can never be mistaken for a real baseline.
docs/gate-baselines.md is the only place real gate numbers live; a fixture that looked like one
would be a second copy of a fact, which is the defect that file exists to end. The controls in
tests/Feature/Docs/GateBaselinesTest.php assert the guard's verdict, never these figures.

Every other line has the shape `gh run view --log` prints (M195): the job, a tab, the step, a tab, then
the timestamp and the text. The generator reads a metric only from its own job's lines, so a line
with no tab, like these, belongs to no job and is never scraped.

### A SEVENTH JOB PRINTS THE SAME SUMMARIES FIRST (M195) ###
The BHW Connect block comes first, as it does in a real run, and prints a Vitest summary, a skip
count and the word flaky. Every metric must still read its own job, so the table this log yields
is the table ci-log.txt yields, row for row.
